title: AI Voice Chatbot Implementation Plan
summary: Task-by-task implementation plan for a Mac Electron voice chatbot app with VAD, STT, LLM, and TTS providers.
notes: Contains Goal/Architecture/Tech Stack summary plus a file map and checkbox-based build steps (Task 1: Project Scaffolding), but no Decision/Consequences sections, no user stories/acceptance criteria, and no API schema/contract tables. Reads as an execution plan rather than ADR, PRD, or SPEC; classified as DOC (implementation planning documentation).
